name: Wild Shape Shift (Combat)
body:
You know how temporarily turn off wild shape without expending a use.

Prerequisite: Wild Shape

Benefit: Once per wild shape, you may return to your normal form for a number of rounds equal to your druid level. Shifting from animal form and back are free actions.
